automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.rule: Only visibly published or updated public sources strictly inside this seven-day window qualify; missing, ambiguous, future-dated, and boundary-only dates are excluded.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub added opt-in industry comparison benchmarks to the Copilot impact dashboard, including agentic adoption, leverage, and agentic versus nonagentic pull-request merge-rate comparisons; peer data is aggregated, region-scoped for data-residency tenants, and deleted after 30 days.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Cost and adoption telemetry should be interpreted against an explicit peer and privacy boundary rather than treated as a standalone utilization score.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub began rolling out enforcement of a one-time global default for eligible unconfigured generally available Copilot features and MCP-server settings, while preserving explicit feature choices and keeping previews opt-in.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local governance practice should retain evidence of intentional feature and MCP authorization choices so an inherited default cannot be mistaken for an explicit approval.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub made REST GET and PATCH endpoints generally available for Copilot model policies at enterprise, enterprise-team, agent-app, and organization levels, with delegated control modes.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Policy automation requires scoped ownership, change evidence, and review of inherited versus delegated controls.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Google announced a preview managed RAG enterprise-search capability for Gemini on Google Distributed Cloud air-gapped, describing operation inside a physical security perimeter without connection to the public internet or Google Cloud global infrastructure.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: For restricted retrieval deployments, provenance and ranking guidance should keep trust, locality, and execution-boundary evidence explicit; the product background belongs upstream.
